needed_streams: Independent room-level Air_Temperature_Sensor streams for rooms inside Core_mid (Zone_F3_Z01) — e.g., Room_F3_R001.Air_Temperature_Sensor, Room_F3_R002.Air_Temperature_Sensor, ... Room_F3_R007.Air_Temperature_Sensor (these points exist in the Brick graph but have no time-series in the store). Any of these would let us compare the zone sensor reading against an independent measurement of the zone's actual air temperature and thereby distinguish a zone sensor fault from a real temperature rise due to local load change. Alternatively, a redundant/second zone-level Air_Temperature_Sensor on Zone_F3_Z01, or zone occupancy / heat-load measurements (e.g., Occupancy_Sensor or plug-load/electricity streams for the zone), would also disambiguate the two causes.

content.text:
Looking at the monthly means, Core_mid (Zone_F3_Z01) shows seasonal variation similar to other core zones, with a modest positive drift relative to Core_bottom in warm months (Aug-Dec) that doesn't persist into Jan 2019. The data we have is only: zone-level temp sensor, zone cooling/heating setpoints, and VAV F3_Z01 damper position setpoint.
